title: AI_ORCHESTRA Human Decision
description: A recorded human action resolving a HUMAN_REQUIRED escalation. This is the only artifact that may move a run out of HUMAN_REQUIRED. Actions and their transitions are defined in policies/ESCALATION_POLICY.md section 3 and policies/ORCHESTRATOR_POLICY.md section 6.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this decision applies to.

action.description: The human action taken. APPROVE resumes at APPROVED; REJECT ends the run as FAILED; MODIFY_SCOPE, INCREASE_BUDGET and RETRY resume the run; CANCEL ends it as CANCELLED.

actor.description: Who issued the decision. Descriptive only; no identity or authentication model exists yet.

reason.description: Why the decision was made. Must not contain credentials, tokens or secret values.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was issued.

resume_state.description: Optional explicit state to resume at. Must be a valid orchestration state, and the resulting HUMAN_REQUIRED -> resume_state transition must still be permitted by ORCHESTRATOR_POLICY.md section 2.1. Omit to use the default re-entry point for the action.

budget_override.description: Optional new limits for this run only, used with INCREASE_BUDGET. Does not amend policies/BUDGET_POLICY.json and does not reset consumed counters. Only the keys below are permitted.
